title: Mannequin-Stand
description: Name an Armor stand the name of a player and it will turn into a mannequin of them.
body:
# Mannequin Stand Summon a mannequin using a player's skin by naming an armor stand with a name tag. ## How to Use Rename an armor stand to: ```txt MN: ``` ### Examples - MN:Steve - MN:Haage - MN:Jeb_ On the next tick, the datapack replaces that armor stand with a mannequin summoned using that player's profile. ### Help Use this command anytime for in-game help: ```mcfunction /trigger mannequin-stand_help ``` ## Features - Summon mannequins with player skins - Matches the direction the armor stand's facing - Copies the armor stand's equipment #### ⚠️ Warning > Armor, tools, and other items equipped on mannequins are **NOT dropped on death**. ## Screenshots
